items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: we formally took that outfit and went into Sweet Emma's Band. Between Poissy and Emma, we worked that outfit.

ctx.x: Yeah, I don't remember that he told us about that particular group.

Yeah, yeah. I'm trying to think now. Who would I want in with after that? We played around here, 45 and let's see. I was doing field work then and working doing Days of Work. And I think in the year of 1950, Johnny Papacelestand's Jazz Band. I worked in there from 50 to 52. The 90s of Papacelestand, New Orleans Jazz Band. I played with him. When I left in that outfit, we went. Then I started working different field work with Poissy Humphrey. And then we started playing and we formally took that outfit and went…
How many years have you been with Emma now?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Me and Poison Humphrey, we'd be playing together like that, on and off, Em and all of us like that.

ctx.x: Uh, so when did you go into Celestan?

Oh, yeah, I was playing, uh, let me see, then we, Me and Poison Humphrey, we were just working together. Them the fellas I forgot to mention. See, when we'd be living in the field, Me and Poison Humphrey, we'd be playing together like that, on and off, Em and all of us like that. And we decided to make that band strong, you know, just make, organize it like. Yeah. But Sweet Em and Esma, she used it. And the name first was titled from Miss Valente at the paddock. She's the one made Em use that adopted name of the…
